verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents a first-party Web API (webapi.teamviewer.com/api/v1/docs), and its pricing page lists API access alongside the audit log, so a documented public API exists. However, the evidence is only a title-level mention: it does not show what operations the API covers or whether it can actually drive sessions and devices. Probes also found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec or llms.txt at the candidate paths, which weakens machine-readable discoverability for agents. Missing for 10: evidence of API scope and endpoints for driving core product actions, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
